goal: the one-shot «Necropolis» (Valley of the Kings, 26 November 1924) playable from the base — material for the owner's own Egyptian campaign (Р-211, item 3 of the queue).
extra:
## This work (Р-214) The scenario «Necropolis» (EN, 23 pages, text layer; find the printed/physical page relation yourself with `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show necropolis-en

` and tell the lead). The Russian file in the folder is a machine translation `[RU-ИИ]` — **not a source, do not read it**. Russian text is our translation (`translated`, Р-21); terms — `python -B tools/terms.py ` and the base's records first. Run tools as `python -B …`. - Records — book-scoped `necropolis-en//` in `kb/books/necropolis-en//`: scenario `necropolis` (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts (player text as printed, in translation), characters (the pre-generated investigators as `roles: ["pregen"]` like other pregens in the base; NPCs with statblocks as printed, Р-25), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`; the book's own monster — a book creature), places. Egypt: the tomb lies in the Valley of the Kings — a shared city record for the nearest town (Luxor — `coc:location:luxor`, create it if missing, Р-190) with «Окрестности Луксора» (`necropolis-luxor-environs`, область) holding the Valley of the Kings and the tomb with its rooms (Р-209). The shared Cairo (`coc:location:cairo`) exists — link it if the hook passes through Cairo. Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/necropolis-.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209). - `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35). - Coverage: `checks/20261112-necropolis/necropolis.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
